title: The plus construction of a separated presheaf is a sheaf
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal G$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$ which is *separated*: for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ of $\mathcal C$ the map $\mathcal G(U)\to\prod_{i\in I}\mathcal G(U_i)$, $s\mapsto(s|_{U_i})_i$, is injective. Let $\mathcal G^+$ be the plus construction of $\mathcal G$ and $\theta:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G^+$ its canonical map [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. Then (a) $\theta_U:\mathcal G(U)\to\mathcal G^+(U)$ is injective for every object $U$; and (b) $\mathcal G^+$ is a sheaf: for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ and every family $s_i\in\mathcal G^+(U_i)$ with $s_i|_{U_i\times_UU_{i'}}=s_{i'}|_{U_i\times_UU_{i'}}$ for all $i,i'\in I$ there is a unique $s\in\mathcal G^+(U)$ with $s|_{U_i}=s_i$ for all $i$.

source.place: Sites, Definition 00WA (definition-separated) and Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus), part (2) (item-sheaf, tag 00WD), with its proof

proof.text: *(a) Injectivity.* The canonical map of a separated presheaf into its plus construction is injective by [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-injective-separated].

source.place: Sites, Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus), part (2), proof of item-sheaf (injectivity of F -> F+ for a separated presheaf)

proof.text: *(b) Existence of a glued section.* Let \{U_i\to U\} be a covering and let s_i\in\mathcal G^+(U_i) have equal restrictions to every U_i\times_UU_{i'}. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (1), choose for each i a covering \{U_{ij}\to U_i\} and a compatible family t_{ij}\in\mathcal G(U_{ij}) representing s_i; [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (3) identifies the restriction of s_i to U_{ij} with \theta(t_{ij}). For every i,i',j,j', pull back the assumed equality to U_{ij}\times_UU_{i'j'}. Naturality of \theta and the injectivity from step (a), applied to the separated presheaf \mathcal G on this object, give equality of the two restrictions of t_{ij} and t_{i'j'}. By the transitivity axiom in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], the family \{U_{ij}\to U\} is a covering; the pairwise equalities therefore put (t_{ij}) in H^0(\{U_{ij}\to U\},\mathcal G) as defined in [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. Let s be its class in \mathcal G^+(U). Applying [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf] (3) to U_i\to U and the subcover \{U_{ij}\to U_i\} shows s|_{U_i}=s_i for every i.

source.place: Sites, Theorem 00WB (theorem-plus), part (2), proof of item-sheaf (local representatives and gluing)

proof.text: *(b) Uniqueness.* If s and s' in \mathcal G^+(U) restrict to the same s_i on the covering \{U_i\to U\}, then [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-plus-separated] applied to the presheaf \mathcal G says that \mathcal G^+ is separated, so s=s'. Thus the glued section is unique.
